title: The Bright Vector
author: Rafael Zhou
blurb: Kestrel Vasquez, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
